title: Advancing sustainability in culinary: examining the role of halal supply chain management and operational efficiency
core_idea: Investigate how halal supply chain management can contribute to sustainability in micro, small, and medium culinary enterprises by exploring operational efficiency as a mediating mechanism.
tldr: Quantitative cross-sectional study of 336 culinary MSME respondents using a structured questionnaire and structural equation modeling to test whether operational efficiency mediates the relationship between halal supply chain management and sustainability.
